findings.title: Tek inişten ortak zamana
findings.claim: The one-time descent of the food-bearing table is asked to become a recurring communal time spanning the first and the later.
findings.mechanism: The focus table carrier contacts the recurring-festival carrier and the first/later endpoints; the supplied 85:13 return pattern and 56:49 first-and-later span make a single descent legible as commemorated across time without repeating the physical descent.

findings.containment: The focus still requests one table to descend; recurrence is the communal observance and memory, not a claim that the table physically descends at every return. The connection rows do not supply target morphology.

findings.title: Gökten gelen rızık olarak yağmur
findings.claim: The closing request for rizq can also open a rain reading: provision is not only food at the table but sky-sent water whose life-sustaining effect reaches the requested sign.
findings.mechanism: The focus r-z-q occurrences contact the registered rain facet at the same carrier positions, while the supplied 6:99, 32:27, and 30:24 connection rows join sky-sent water to vegetation, food, signs, and reflection; the focus sky and descent provide the return path.
findings.reader_payoff: Rizq opens from the meal on the table toward the water that makes nourishment possible, while remaining tied to a visible sign from above.
findings.containment: The table and edible-provision reading remain intact; rain is a bounded alternative activation of the r-z-q branch, not a claim that rizq universally means rain. The connection rows supply no target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The registered focus rain branch and exact connection targets supply a concrete carrier and return, but the connection evidence has no target morphology or cited support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Gönderge, gökten düşen yağmur veya yağmur suyudur.

branch_activations.activation: The requested provision returns through the sky-sent water that produces edible yield, allowing rizq to include the rain that makes the table possible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Rizq can be heard as sky-sent rain as well as the food-bearing share placed before the community.
branch_activations.boundary: The rain branch is bounded to the supplied focus contact and does not erase the ordinary food sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yağmurun canlılığı ve toprağın üretkenliğini sürdürmesi adlandırmayı açıklar.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus r-z-q forms carry provision as the life-sustaining share received by people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 6:99, 32:27, and 30:24 rows each connect water from above with revived land, crops, food, signs, or reflection.
branch_activations.activation: The wider water-and-growth pattern returns to the focus provision request, changing its material scope from a served meal to the sustaining process behind it.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The requested provision includes the rain whose productive effect keeps nourishment available and visible.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a qualified connection-based resonance; it does not broaden the rain branch to every beneficial thing or claim target-side morphology.

friction_notes: Legacy-unbound HFT records supply exact anchor ayat and source word indices but no independently verified lexical descriptor for several retained branches; those activations remain attributed and qualified.
Connection target morphology is not supplied for the wider recurrence and rain triggers, so those findings retain qualified status and bounded containment.
